top_signals.title: Gold Gains as Iran Talks Ease Concerns Over Interest-Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Gold advanced after US President Donald Trump said fresh negotiations with Iran would begin later Monday, raising hopes for a breakthrough in the months-long conflict that would ease energy-driven inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Treasury’s Firepower for Yen Support May Be Limited, JPM Says
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury has limited liquid resources to support further coordinated currency intervention alongside Japan, though its firepower could be expanded substantially if officials resort to more extraordinary measures, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
